system.description:
When viewed from the corner of the eye, the rune appears to contain shapes moving behind its engraved lines.

You gain Spirit Sense as a tertiary sense. When Searching, you can detect the presence and general direction of disembodied spirits, incorporeal Undead, haunts and active possession within range.

Veilwatch does not provide exact location, identity or allegiance and does not by itself allow you to target an entity you cannot otherwise perceive.

Inscribed onto armour.

On the sheet: Applied automatically: Spirit Sense (30 feet, tertiary) joins your senses while the armour is worn. It gives presence and direction, never identity or a target.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
